# Support & Community

Thank you for using **Lumio Photos (TeleDrive)**!

## Getting Help
- **GitHub Discussions**: For general questions, setup discussions, and feature ideas.
- **GitHub Issues**: For verified bug reports and concrete feature proposals.
- **Security Inquiries**: Please consult our [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) for confidential security disclosures.

## Important Note on Telegram API
Lumio Photos connects directly from your web browser to Telegram Data Centers using standard MTProto WebSockets. No middleman servers ever handle your files, sessions, or photos.
